name: APEX Signature
description:
APEX Signature allows you to capture signatures with customizable tools, save templates, and sign documents. Features include drawing with color/thickness controls, image upload, webcam capture, undo/redo, eraser mode, saved signature templates, and document signing with PDF overlay.

Version 3.3.0 New Features:

  • Customization Toolbar: Real-time pen color and thickness controls
  • Color picker with 5 preset colors + custom picker
  • Line thickness slider (0.5 - 5.0 px)
  • Eraser mode to erase parts of signature
  • Undo/Redo with full stroke history
  • Keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Y, E)
  • Preference persistence in localStorage

Version 3.2.0 Features:

  • Signature Templates: Save signatures as reusable templates
  • Gallery view with thumbnails for saved signatures

Version 3.1.0 Features:

  • Document Signing: Upload PDF/image and place signatures
  • Drag-and-drop signature positioning

Version 3.0.0 Features:

  • Multi-Input Capture: Draw, Upload, or Webcam modes
  • Universal Theme and Dark mode support
